organization.rule: Use fabricated records, minimize retained data, and require humans for real-world actions.

application.rule: Give each agent only its allowlisted tool and mask supported PII.

model.rule: Use approved deterministic local mocks with no API keys or runtime network.

runtime.rule: Reject requests before execution when token or reference-cost limits are exceeded.

risk.justification: This is a customer-support ticket assistant: it handles operational records and can influence customer communication, but it cannot make payments, change tickets, issue refunds, or access real Ola systems. Privacy masking, grounded evidence, least-autonomy tool access, bounded review, and human ownership of real actions are therefore required.

first_result.question: Is routine support open Sunday?
first_result.answer: Routine support operates Monday through Saturday from 09:00 to 18:00 Indian Standard Time, using the Asia/Kolkata time zone. Routine support is closed on Sundays and on the project holidays of 26 January, 15 August, and 2 October.
